description: Use this when a song should move between MTL text, a Moose Tracker .mtk project, a share link and standard files: MIDI (.mid, type 0 or 1) and MOD, XM, S3M or IT tracker modules, in either direction, or sheet music: in from MusicXML (.musicxml/.xml), compressed MusicXML (.mxl), ABC notation, or a PDF that has the MusicXML or MIDI attached, and out to MusicXML 4.0 (to musicxml, for MuseScore, Dorico, Finale or Sibelius; key and time override the inferred key and the song's time signature; layout full (every part), voice-piano (the vocal line with lyrics and chord symbols over a grand-staff piano) or lead-sheet (the melody with lyrics and chord symbols; diagrams adds guitar chord boxes); parts sets a part off or on 1 or 2 staves by its key, listed in the reply's notes; to pdf or svg: a link that opens the song in the web app with the engraved PDF/SVG export ready). Files come in as base64 in input (MusicXML and ABC also as plain text) or as an https address in url; from file works the type out. An import to mtl returns the MTL plus a share link (or the .mtk as a download when the song is long); a written file comes back as a download link; describe topic=formats. It takes a song into another program (a DAW, a notation app, another tracker) or brings one in; voices maps channels to sample packs or presets on import, and feel adds swing or humanize. Cues and macros are compiled away in .mtk and share links. from photo reads a photo or scan of printed sheet music (optical music recognition with homr, run on the user's own computer; describe topic=photos): the photo comes as photo (a file attached in ChatGPT), url, base64 input, upload (the job id from the scan link or upload card) or path (a file on the user's computer, with the moosetracker-mcp package), and the import returns a draft song plus the bars to compare with the photo. Schema 0479948e.

bassFill.description: to musicxml, pdf or svg: a piano with nothing for the left hand plays the bass part there (default: on for voice-piano)

chords.description: to musicxml, pdf or svg: chord symbols from the harmony (default: on for voice-piano and lead-sheet, and for full scores with a chordal part)

diagrams.description: to musicxml, pdf or svg: guitar chord diagrams with the chord symbols

input.description: The song, .mtk JSON or share link; for a file, the file as base64 (up to about 700 KB; MusicXML and ABC may be plain text). Omit when url is given

key.description: to musicxml: the key, e.g. "Eb major", "F# minor" (default: worked out from the notes)

layout.description: to musicxml, pdf or svg: full score (default), voice and piano, or lead sheet

name.description: The file's name, e.g. tune.mxl (helps from file tell the type)

parts.description: to musicxml: per part key ("3" = channel 3, "4d" = the drums of channel 4): "off", or "1" or "2" staves

path.description: from photo: the photo's full path on the user's computer (read by the moosetracker-mcp package there)

photo.description: from photo: the photo of the sheet music as a file attached in the chat (ChatGPT fills this in)

time.description: to musicxml: time signature, e.g. "3/4", "6/8" (default: the song's)

upload.description: from photo: the job id of a photo uploaded with the scan link or the upload card

url.description: Instead of input: a public https address of the file (up to about 700 KB)

name: convert
title: Convert song formats
